rules.statement: An authority to execute an instrument, which under the law must be notarially executed, can be given orally.
rules.supporting_quote: "As to the facts, it appears that the plaintiff some years ago received from her late husband a transfer of the property in dispute. Before she had received that transfer she had given her husband a power of attorney authorizing him to transact business in her name, the object being that as she was a Muhammadan woman she need not be troubled to subject herself to the publicity which the execution of notarial documents involves."
